Eagle Wireless

MES Software Engineer

MES Software Engineer

About Eagle Wireless

Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.

Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.

Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.

If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens. 

Job Summary: 

Join our internal software team to develop and extend our in-house Manufacturing Execution System (MES). You'll work directly with our electronics manufacturing line to integrate production equipment, build end-to-end product traceability, and connect manufacturing data with operations and fulfillment systems. 

Key Duties & Responsibilities: 

Develop and maintain MES services that integrate with production line equipment, inspection systems, and line management software. 
Design and implement traceability across work orders, serial numbers, parts, lots, and material consumption. 
Integrate MES data with operations, fulfillment, and ERP systems. 
Maintain production databases, including schema changes, data retention, and backups. 
Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot MES services. 
Build operator-facing tools for job setup and production preparation. 
Work on the production floor with operators and manufacturing staff to understand processes and resolve issues. 

Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge: 

0–5 years of software development experience, including production systems. 
Strong programming skills (we use Python). 
Experience designing and working with relational databases. 
Experience building and maintaining integrations between systems. 
Data modeling experience, ideally for traceability, inventory, or transactional systems. 
Experience supporting live systems where downtime has a business impact. 
Ability to work from limited documentation and make design decisions independently. 
Solid programming fundamentals. 
Ability to learn new tools and systems quickly. 
Interest in manufacturing and working hands-on with production equipment. 
MES, manufacturing, industrial, or embedded software experience. 
Electronics manufacturing environments. 
ERP integration. 
Production metrics and reporting. 
Internship, co-op, or project experience in manufacturing. 

 

Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO, and paid parental leave programs.  

Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.
